# connectracer_connect_app_integration (Resource)

Manages an AWS AppIntegrations Application resource.

This creates an Application (e.g., an MCP Server integration, or an external AI agent Connect collaborates with over the A2A protocol) that can then be associated with an Amazon Connect instance using the `connectracer_connect_integration_association` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An MCP server that an AI agent can call as a tool.
resource "connectracer_connect_app_integration" "mcp_server" {
  name             = "order-tools"
  namespace        = "order-tools"
  description      = "MCP server with the order lookup tools"
  access_url       = "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"
  application_type = "MCP_SERVER"
}

# An external AI agent that Connect collaborates with over the A2A protocol.
# Connect presents the secret's value as the bearer token on the WebSocket
# upgrade, so the secret has to be encrypted with a customer managed KMS key
# whose policy lets connect.amazonaws.com decrypt it.
resource "connectracer_connect_app_integration" "voice_agent" {
  name             = "voice-agent"
  namespace        = "voice-agent"
  description      = "External voice agent, reached over A2A"
  access_url       = "wss://agents.example.com/a2a/voice-agent"
  application_type = "A2A_SERVER"

  auth_config = {
    auth_type                      = "API_KEY"
    credential_provider_identifier = aws_secretsmanager_secret.voice_agent_api_key.arn
  }
}

# Either application reaches the Connect instance through an association.
resource "connectracer_connect_integration_association" "voice_agent" {
  instance_id      = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
  integration_type = "APPLICATION"
  integration_arn  = connectracer_connect_app_integration.voice_agent.arn
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_url` (String) The URL to access the application (the external URL source). For `A2A_SERVER`, the agent's public `wss://` or `https://` endpoint.
- `name` (String) The name of the application.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the application.

### Optional

- `application_type` (String) The type of the application. Valid values: `STANDARD`, `SERVICE`, `MCP_SERVER`, `A2A_SERVER`. `A2A_SERVER` requires `auth_config`.
- `auth_config` (Attributes) How Amazon Connect authenticates to the application. Required for `A2A_SERVER`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth_config))
- `description` (String) The description of the application.
- `permissions` (List of String) The configuration of events or requests that the application has access to.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags to apply to the application.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the application.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the application.

<a id="nestedatt--auth_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth_config`

Required:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication type. Valid value: `API_KEY`.
- `credential_provider_identifier` (String) The ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the credential. Connect presents its value as the bearer token, so the secret has to be encrypted with a customer managed KMS key that Connect may use.
